text: The Patriots dismantled the Raiders 45-17 at Gillette Stadium on Sunday—a dominant performance all the more impressive given the roster constraints they were operating under, with Drake Maye accounting for five total touchdowns despite missing his top receiver and being forced to navigate the game without both starting cornerbacks. The victory came at a cost, however, as the Patriots lost RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell (knee) during the win, both departing with injuries and not returning to the field. Adding to New England's injury woes heading into the contest, the team had already placed veteran WR Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday due to a calf injury, meaning Maye and the offense were simply stacked with adversity yet still found ways to dominate on the scoreboard.
